head: working-tree
subject: MQTT $SYS version and client aliases
change: Broker system statistics now publish $SYS/broker/version ("netz version 0.1.0") and Mosquitto's $SYS/broker/clients/active and $SYS/broker/clients/inactive aliases next to the existing connected/disconnected topics. The aliases read the same live-connection and disconnected-session gauges, and periodic retained publication includes them through the normal $SYS routing and ACL path.

tests.unit: src/mqtt/broker.zig checks the three topic strings and the version payload. src/mqtt/broker_tests.zig extends the coherent retained statistics test to read seven $SYS/broker/clients/# messages and updates the following sent-message and sent-PUBLISH counts to include the two new retained publications.

focused_gate.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='coherent retained system statistics' -Dtest-filter='SYS version and client aliases' --summary all

notes: The version string is a static package-version payload like Mosquitto's build version topic; the aliases are exact duplicates of the connected and disconnected gauges, matching Mosquitto's $SYS tree. They are retained QoS 0 messages published through system_stats_interval.
